notablePrerequisites: You control at least five basic Swamps.
description:
Activate Cabal Stronghold's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Cabal Stronghold.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Cabal Stronghold.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Locus of Enlightenment
